basis: Every original facet is covered and clear of actual terrain in four coordinate representations. All child support warnings are bound to exact finite contacts, bounded paths or the previously scoped Tower 3A facade attachments. The seven tower projection warnings reproduce entirely against the original podium, with identical flagged face sets, and do not occur against terrain. Four-angle source views show repeated lower facade projections/closure facets beneath elevated podium layers; these are reviewed as the unchanged original assembly, not as terrain burial. This does not certify structural engineering, assert that every source part is disjoint, or suppress the raw overlap records. Both terrain-founded podiums separately satisfy the existing ground-contact limits.

sourceContexts.interpretation: Original lower facade/projecting or closure facets situated beneath elevated surfaces of the companion original podium. The highest-surface projection is not ground level here; preserve both source parts and their raw overlap flags.
